title: Uniform finite-periodic kinetic character moment corollary
question: Does the registered onsite coercivity and fifth Gibbs moment give a volume/source-uniform two-sided Gibbs seminorm bound for the kinetic part of delta_H^2(W_a) without a modular multiplier hypothesis?

model.scope: Registered finite periodic Q3 volumes at fixed beta, compact onsite sources, uniform site translates; arbitrary boundaries remain outside scope.

proof_boundary.kinetic_part: The two seminorm orientations reduce algebraically to p_x+a/2 and p_x-a/2; no uniform M_0(W_a) is used.
proof_boundary.force_part: The local force summand from EXP-001067 is not silently included; a full-force second moment remains a separate input.
proof_boundary.thermodynamic_use: The bound is uniform over the registered finite periodic family and is a necessary input to, but not a direct D/delta-D exhaustion theorem.

scope.not_closed: This package closes only the kinetic contribution for local configuration characters in the registered finite periodic compact-source scope. It does not close the force contribution, the full double commutator, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: The onsite coercivity and m5 are reused only in the registered finite periodic compact-source family; no arbitrary-boundary or all-shape extension is inferred.
p_x^2/(2 chi)<=k_x and k_x>=1 imply p_x^4<=4 chi^2 k_x^5 by functional calculus; no unregistered moment is inserted.
The scalar bound |u+v|^4<=8(|u|^4+|v|^4) is applied to both p_x+a/2 and p_x-a/2, with the derived a^4 term retained.
W_a p_x W_a^*=p_x-a is used only inside W_a P_plus^4 W_a^*, so the second seminorm orientation becomes phi(P_minus^4) exactly.
No bound on rho^t W_a rho^-t is assumed; the cancellation is an algebraic two-sided seminorm identity for this character.
The force summand is not hidden inside the kinetic bound; full Q3 force control remains open.
Uniformity is only over the upstream registered finite periodic family and does not identify a common OS representation or an exhaustion limit.
R250 checks exact rational shift and fixture arithmetic only; it does not formalize unbounded operator domains or the upstream m5 theorem.
A kinetic seminorm input is not Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, common alpha, KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A closure.

qft_interface.open: The force summand, full double commutator, actual Q3 history, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
